title: Frontend runtime harness cannot launch repository-local TypeScript on Windows
environment: Windows x64; Python 3.13.14; repository-local TypeScript under cpf-admin/frontend/node_modules/.bin
actualError: FileNotFoundError WinError 2 while subprocess attempts bare tsc
rootCause: The harness assumes a global executable named tsc. The maintained Workspace provides tsc.cmd through the repository-local frontend toolchain and Windows CreateProcess cannot discover it from the harness contract.
sourceFix: The harness resolves cpf-admin/frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc first with PATH fallback and dispatches cmd/bat through the Windows command processor while executing native binaries directly on POSIX.
verification: Actual repository command reaches repository TypeScript 6 then after F155 compiles both actual ADM and Backoffice client surfaces and passes the Node behavior harness.
passCriteria: Resolve repository-local TypeScript deterministically with PATH fallback
Launch cmd/bat tooling safely on Windows and the binary directly on POSIX
Compile both actual ADM and Backoffice client paths
Run the Node behavioral harness to completion
